concept: EventBridge: rule-based event routing to multiple targets
tests: Choosing a service for an event-driven architecture: filter S3 events and route them to different targets (Lambda, SQS) by rules.
expected: Amazon EventBridge — an event bus; rules filter events (including S3) and route them to multiple targets. Triggers: "event-driven", "filter events", "route to different targets based on rules".
why_not: SQS standard — a single buffer; Step Functions orchestrate workflows but aren't an event bus; Firehose delivers streams to storage.
